GUIYANG · CHENGDU

Two shots at the blossom, then four slow days in Chengdu.

Three nights in Guiyang for two shots at the Pingba cherry blossom, then a G train to Chengdu for pandas, teahouses and the Leshan Buddha. The bloom timing is a gamble.

Guiyang
3 nights
Chengdu

Book and check, in order

  1. Before Mar 27Sanxingdui Museum. Book the Saturday slot online. It has been one of the busiest museums in China.
  2. Before Mar 27Sichuan opera. Book Shufeng Yayun a day ahead.
  3. Mar 24Sour soup fish. Book a proper sit-down dinner for your last Guiyang night.
  4. Mar 28Airport car. Arrange the car to Tianfu the night before, for a 07:00 start.
  5. Mar 28Qingcheng train. It leaves from Chengdu Xibu, a third station. Check your ticket.

Day by day

Mon 22 MarArrival
Arrive Monday lunchtime. Three nights in Guiyang.
  • Guiyang sits at about 1,100 m, so evenings run colder.
  • About 15 rain days in March. Pack a real shell.
Tue 23 MarNatureScenic1h00 driving
Pingba cherry blossom, the main shot. Be inside by 07:00.
  • Gui’an (Pingba) Cherry Blossom Garden, 700,000 trees, free entry MUST-SEE. Shuttle about CNY 15 one way.
  • About an hour by car. Best windows: 07:00 to 11:00 and after 17:00.
  • Ask staff which zone is best today. Higher north facing slopes lag by days.
  • Zones: Fanying Square, Xunying Garden, Manying Garden. Tuesday leaves Wednesday as a second try.
Wed 24 MarNatureFood
Back to Pingba if Tuesday was thin, else Qingyan.
  • Decide at breakfast. If Tuesday was thin or early, return to Pingba. Only the drive costs.
  • If Tuesday delivered: Qingyan Ancient Town, 29 km, about 27 minutes by car or a CNY 10 bus.
  • Eat on the main lane: rose sugar cake, braised pig’s trotters, tofu balls.
  • If it rains: Huangla Village, smaller and quieter. Finish with sour soup fish for dinner MUST-SEE.
Thu 25 MarTravelArrival
G train to Chengdu East, about 3 hours. Lunch there.
  • Guiyang North to Chengdu East, about 3 hours. 84 pairs a day, so mid morning is easy.
  • Arrive early afternoon and drop bags.
  • Gentle first afternoon: People’s Park and Heming teahouse, bamboo chairs and refillable tea.
  • Evening: Jinli, Taikoo Li or Chengdu hotpot, milder than Chongqing’s.

Know before you go

  • White bloom peaks about ten days in mid March. Mar 23 is late for white, inside the pink.
  • Past years: 2024 only about 40% open on Mar 20. 2026 had petal fall by Mar 17.
  • Guiyang is at 1,100 m, colder evenings, about 15 rain days in March. Pack a real shell.

Day by day

Fri 26 MarCultureScenicTravel
Leshan Giant Buddha, on your only weekday.
  • Train Chengdu to Leshan, about 1 hour, CNY 41 to 55 second class, then bus or taxi.
  • Leshan Giant Buddha, 71 metres MUST-SEE. Allow 2 to 3 hours.
  • Go to the cliff stairway first, then loop the temples. Weekend queues run two hours.
  • The boat shows the whole Buddha in about 30 minutes. Back for dinner, 8 hours door to door.
Sat 27 MarNatureCulture
Pandas at opening, then bronze masks at Sanxingdui.
  • Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding, gate at about 07:30 MUST-SEE.
  • Pandas feed and move 08:00 to 10:00, then sleep through midday.
  • Afternoon: Sanxingdui Museum, Guanghan MUST-SEE. Rail from Chengdu North 18 minutes, about CNY 8; entry about CNY 72.
  • Book Sanxingdui online in advance. Saturday slots sell out.
Sun 28 MarScenicCulture
Mount Qingcheng if you have the legs, else a slow city day.
  • If rested: Mount Qingcheng and Dujiangyan, intercity train 30 to 40 minutes from Chengdu Xibu.
  • Taoist temples, forest paths and irrigation works from 256 BC that still work.
  • If tired: stay put. Wuhou Shrine, Jinli, Jinsha Site Museum, a teahouse afternoon.
  • Evening: Sichuan opera at Shufeng Yayun, book a day ahead. Pack tonight, early start.
Mon 29 MarTravel
Early start, home by mid afternoon.
  • SQ 847 departs Chengdu Tianfu 10:00, lands Singapore 15:10. 5h10, CNY 1,350 Economy.
  • The airport is about 50 km out. Be there by 08:00, leave the city about 07:00.
  • Arrange the car the night before. Do not gamble on a morning Didi.

Know before you go

  • Only one weekday, Friday, so Leshan takes it. Its cliff stairway queue doubles at weekends.
  • Sunday is optional: Qingcheng if you have the legs, a teahouse if not.
  • Chengdu has its own cherry blossom in late March. Ask the hotel what is out.
